snippet.title: Battlefield 6 Season 2 Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Adapt and survive as Season 2 goes live February 17 across Battlefield 6 and REDSEC.

Season 2 introduces high-intensity combat with the expansive map Contaminated and a grueling assault to reclaim a once-owned NATO airbase in the mountains of Germany. VL-7 psychoactive smoke distorts the battlefield, alongside three new weapons, two new gadgets, and the return of the AH-6 Little Bird.

Extreme Measures sets the tone for the conflict as the fight escalates.

Watch the Season 2 Intro Cinematic: https://youtu.be/a_Ih_1bWR3s 

#Battlefield6
